heading.title: Provisions as to Bail and Bonds

article.title: Declaration by sureties
article.content: Every person standing surety to an accused person for his release on bail, shall make a declaration before the Court as to the number of persons to whom he has stood surety including the accused, giving therein all the relevant particulars.
article.html:
486Declaration by sureties

Section 486 · Chapter XXXV

Every person standing surety to an accused person for his release on bail, shall make a declaration before the Court as to the number of persons to whom he has stood surety including the accused, giving therein all the relevant particulars.
